QUOTE: `detokenize()` (lines 92-104) has the same shape with `llama_token_to_piece`: a 256-byte stack buffer, and an exact-size second call if the first is too small.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer mentions the 256-byte stack buffer for detokenize, but it never contrasts this with tokenize's size-first approach. It also never says detokenize heap-allocates only when the token doesn't fit. It describes both as having "the same shape," which is the opposite of the contrast the item requires.
